description: Fetch one catalog product in the selected workspace by product id or SKU — returned in any status (draft, active, or archived; check the status field) — with every catalog field: prices, cost, stock and trackInventory, availability, variant fields, all attributes (characteristics) and translations, identifiers, weight and dimensions, images, videos, bundle components and related products; plus its model, warehouse and supplier by name, supplierOffers (what the supplier last said: quantity, restock date, purchase price, state), every sales channel with its listing and moderation state, the collections it is in and its model's review summary. A bundle's stock and cost are derived from its components. Provide exactly one known identifier; use search_products first when unsure (search covers active products only).

id.description: The product id returned by search_products.

sku.description: The product SKU returned by search_products.

name: get_product
title: Get product
